BrochureContent.Content:
DNG McCormack Quinn is delighted to offer this light filled detached dormer residence standing on a 0.5 acre site with a sunny south facing garden. Freshly painted inside and out, the property offers a perfect canvas for prospective buyers and is well maintained with all modern conveniences.

The property is extremely well located. Nestled between the charming villages of Duncormick and Rathangan it is just 6 kms from the picturesque fishing village Kilmore Quay and a short 20 minute drive from Wexford Town. Dublin lies on a straight run less than 2 hours away.

The property offers bright spacious living accommodation with marble flooring throughout the hall, kitchen/dining, sun room, utility and guest w.c. to the ground floor. A large living room and a separate family room offer a choice of relaxing and entertainment options

A split level staircase leads to a bright spacious landing, a large family bathroom and four bedrooms, two of which are en-suite. 

The south facing garden has stunning views over Kilmore Dunes and the surrounding countryside. On foot from the house is a lovely walk leading to the waters edge at Blackstone with breathtaking views.

The property is close to numerous beaches including Kilmore and Cullenstown with Rosslare strand 25 minutes away. Popular spots like Johnstown Castle and the JFK Park and Arboretum are nearby with Hook Head and Tintern Abbey within easy access. Schools and activities are locally available. 

There are numerous good restaurants in the locality including Mary Barrys in Kilmore and Kehoes in Kilmore Quay as well as Rathangan Bar and Restaurant - just minutes away. 

For further information or an appointment to view please contact the sole selling agents.
